verdict.rationale: Tavily ships a first-party Crawl endpoint, described as 'graph-based website traversal' with parallel path exploration and built-in extraction. It is exposed in the SDK, with natural-language instructions, and in the CLI with a --depth flag, alongside a Map endpoint for discovering site structure from a base URL. Any search-result URL can be passed as the crawl's starting point. Missing for 10: documented direct chaining from search results into crawl, and independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl depth and coverage at full-site scale.
